grades.quote: If the length and sign of the source operand and the destination operand are the same, the instruction name will have only one suffix.
grades.reason: It explains the LoongArch mnemonic suffix convention, where one suffix means the source and destination have the same length and sign, and a U suffix marks unsigned sources. This helps in inferring operand interpretation for MULH.D and MULH.DU. It does not mention these instructions or their high-half result directly.
